rules.camera: Screen-aligned elevated orthographic. No diamond isometric yaw or per-map camera tilt.
rules.palette: Reuse canonical warm wood, cream paper, charcoal equipment and muted foliage material ramps; retain character identities.
rules.composition: A legible home or destination silhouette, quiet walking lanes, recognizable focal activity and meaningful boundary. Avoid unexplained empty floor.
rules.props: Reuse registered catalog facing profiles with their own pivots, layers and footprint. No raster rotation or baked character/furniture composites.
rules.navigation: A real spawn and reachable return; visible terrain is not automatically walkable. Decorative exits must not imply implemented travel.
rules.review: Current actual-Godot captures at native scale with an actor, entrance/return, depth crossings and navigation tests. Automated geometry does not certify artistic quality.
